reviews.name: Ayesha R.
reviews.text: The nikah pens were the talk of the ceremony. Our names in gold, the florals so fine you have to lean in. Everyone asked where we got them.

reviews.name: Sana & Imran
reviews.text: Ordered from Dubai, arrived in nine days, wrapped like treasure. The gold catches the evening light in our living room.

reviews.name: Priya K.
reviews.text: I sent our wedding song and date, and the hamper came back with both lettered on a tiny canvas. My husband went quiet for a full minute.

reviews.name: Fatima Z.
reviews.text: My daughter's name in Arabic and English, exactly as I imagined. They sent a proof on WhatsApp before painting, which I loved.

reviews.name: Rahul M.
reviews.text: The kintsugi workshop was the calmest three hours of my month. I came home with a gold-mended bowl I actually use.

reviews.name: Nida S.
reviews.text: They built my sister's trousseau box from scratch, matched to her lehenga colour. Worth every rupee.

reviews.name: Meera T.
reviews.text: Stunning tray, heavier than I expected in a good way. Delivery took a day longer than promised, but they kept me updated.

reviews.name: Omar H.
reviews.text: Ordered 60 desk sets for our Ramadan client gifting. Every one matched our brand colours and arrived on schedule.
